title: ClearPath Relationship and the Build of Network and Server Order Deposits
content:
The deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote is built by the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services relationship:

(a) a client with no active ClearPath agreement pays a deposit equal to the distributor cost of the units, the distributor unit cost times the quantity, whatever the percentage;

(b) a client whose active ClearPath agreement went live fewer than **48** whole months before the approval day pays the order's service charges, the quote total less the quantity times the unit price, in full, plus the deposit percentage of the quantity times the unit price;

(c) every other client pays the deposit percentage of the quote total.

Whole months are counted from the go-live date, a month completing only once the day of the month reaches the go-live date's day number; the go-live date is the one on the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active.

## The builds, worked (hypothetical quote; percentage taken as 40 for the illustration)

Hypothetical quote: 2 units, distributor unit cost 3000.00, unit price 3540.00, quote total 7445.00 (units 7080.00 plus 365.00 of service charges).

| Client | Deposit |
|---|---|
| no active agreement | 2 times 3000.00, that is 6000.00 |
| agreement live 47 whole months | 365.00 plus 40 percent of 7080.00, that is 365.00 plus 2832.00, giving 3197.00 |
| agreement live 48 whole months | 40 percent of 7445.00, that is 2978.00 |

For an agreement that went live on the 1st of a month, the 48th whole month completes on the 1st of the same month four years later.
